records.claim: Agent Skills directories are the strongest current portable procedure format shared by Hermes and Codex.
records.implication: Keep one canonical Agent Skills tree and use host adapters only for discovery and lifecycle integration.

records.claim: One universal hook schema can be the portable enforcement surface for Hermes and Codex.
records.implication: Specify safety outcomes portably and implement only the smallest necessary host-native policy adapters.

records.claim: Current required-host evidence admits the staged capability-curator across Codex and Hermes.
records.implication: Historical mixed evidence remains useful, but both current lanes ended in verified harness failures. Their sealed attempt budgets cannot contain a complete rerun, so the cross-host result is inconclusive and the owner stays staged without treating either failure as behavioral rejection.

records.claim: The staged surface-convergence skill currently improves semantic host mapping across all required Codex and Hermes cases.
records.implication: Historical Codex development evidence remains positive, but the current Hermes episode is inadmissible: a stopped wrapper left its evaluator child running, that child overlapped the rerun, the earlier raw report was overwritten before archival, and the surviving report is bound to candidate and baseline hashes different from the sealed plan. The two reports consumed 63 of 72 attempts, leaving only 9 against a 56-attempt clean minimum. No Codex lane was started; keep the owner staged and treat this as integrity failure, not behavioral rejection.

records.claim: Aggregate leaderboards and token throughput are insufficient to select delegation routes; current task-class workflow evidence must gate speed- or intelligence-constrained routes.
records.implication: Use external data to prefilter model-effort candidates, then select each task route by verified pass probability under hard p95 latency and expected-cost constraints.

records.claim: OpenAI news RSS can provide a cheap release-change signal but contains case studies and unrelated model mentions, so a scheduled run must verify release semantics and callability before evaluation.
records.implication: Use a deterministic monitor for suppression, then let the agent verify official release/update evidence and local availability; never auto-promote from the detector.

records.claim: The current local evidence admits either Honcho or Hindsight as one canonical shared-memory provider across Hermes, Codex, and OMP.
records.implication: No comparative provider winner exists. A later real-history utility audit found no repeatable external-only downstream win across the user's ordinary workload, so Hermes retired Honcho and Hindsight runtime state and retained built-in curated memory, authoritative artifacts, skills, and exact session retrieval. This does not disprove future bounded semantic recall or person-model use cases; reopen only for a repeated concrete miss that the incumbent cannot recover.

records.claim: The historical 2026-08-15 local Honcho backfill was complete and its processing queue was healthy for the evaluated Hermes history window.
records.implication: Historical only: retrieval misses in that trial were not caused by an ingestion backlog. Honcho has since been retired; exact transcript retrieval remains the incumbent.

records.claim: Current Luna-high and Sol-low evidence is sufficient to promote an evidence-selected route across Hermes delegation, cc-dynamic-workflows, Kanban, Codex, and OMP.
records.implication: Treat the cc-dynamic-workflow and Kanban samples as historical negative evidence only. The portable owner is skills/dynamic-workflows; unsupported compatibility surfaces are retired rather than repaired or promoted.

records.claim: The current self-authored evaluation owner alone prevents a design or implementation principal from certifying material work and detects the preserved human-off orchestration blockers.
records.implication: Retain the existing eval runners but require the grounded contract for material work: verifier-supplied immutable freeze and test-author roots, complete amendment chains, evolving multi-turn intent lineage, summary non-authority, research-first cross-host resume, proactive no-reminder status, evidence-based legacy done classification, criterion-to-decision-scope mappings, complete digest-bound evidence lanes, distinct principals, sealed access boundaries, negative controls, property/metamorphic and teeth evidence, world-state oracles, and an independently bounded verdict. Narrow receipts cannot inflate into broader comparison, architecture, or promotion authority. The pilot detected all 16 preserved blockers with no observed false positives or false negatives, while explicitly leaving downstream Hermes/Codex/OMP/Prime outcomes not evaluated; external framework adoption remains unproven.

records.claim: The GitHub follow-up extension improves identification and reusable learning from merged replacements without regressing unrelated, preference-only, or already-owned cases.
records.implication: Track terminal authored PR outcomes, verify actual replacements against both implementations and current base, and change an owning rule only for a novel evidence-backed lesson. The first held-out run exposed duplicate retention of an already-owned production-seam lesson; the corrected candidate explicitly makes that case a no-edit confirmation and then won a fresh held-out owner-update case.

records.claim: GitHub follow-up now treats outcomes as candidate engineering evidence and promotes a general rule only after deterministic matched evaluation on unrelated held-out code.
records.implication: Use real PR/review/CI/replacement evidence to propose narrow lessons, keep project conventions local, inspect the existing owner first, and make no persistent rule edit on a tie, loss, missing/inconclusive gate, or already-owned lesson. GitHub-only procedure fixes stay on their direct-test path.

records.claim: The latest preserved Luna-high and Sol-low smokes qualify as current verified routes for Hermes 0.20.5 delegation.
records.implication: Keep the incumbent unchanged. The shared selector and immutable run pin are working staged artifacts, but routes remain fail-closed until current task-and-surface samples establish p95, total expected cost, cleanup, and the required native integration seams. The failed Hermes compatibility DAG is retired; it is not a repair or promotion candidate.

records.claim: Hermes in-place Responses-native compaction on the base GPT-5.6 Sol route materially outperforms the rotating local-compressor baseline without requiring the 900K alias or a third-party context engine.
records.implication: Keep gpt-5.6-sol and the built-in compressor, enable in-place and Codex Responses-native compaction, keep the 900K alias opt-in, and do not install hermes-lcm on the current Windows host until its externalized-storage/recovery boundary passes intact.

records.claim: The active Windows Hermes LCM runtime contains the repair for the prior directory-fsync blocker and currently passes its storage, integrity, configuration, and context-pressure health checks; the earlier comparative recall benchmark has not been rerun.
records.implication: Preserve the active LCM engine and threshold in recovery, keep native compaction enabled, inspect lifecycle-fragmentation warnings without automatic cleanup, and do not claim comparative recall superiority without a new matched rerun.

records.claim: Routine user-facing status should compress presentation without reducing internal reasoning, verification, execution, or safety.
records.implication: Use one natural status phrase by default; omit headings, ordinary mechanics, and negative clarifications unless they change the decision or next action.

records.claim: A schema-v3 evaluator plus the staged pre-public PR workflow reliably separates critical operational decisions, semantic quality, judge instability, and route mismatch, and the exact candidate improves fresh GitHub PR decision cases without observed regression.
records.implication: Before a public PR mutation, keep one writer and choose publish, hold, rescope, or handoff from current-base, clean-environment, negative-control, and risk-scaled read-only review evidence. Preserve raw judge variance, resolve it only through the bounded panel, and fail closed on any unresolved disagreement, route mismatch, loss, or critical receipt failure.

records.claim: The exact v0.1.3 global-learning-intake candidate is ready for promotion across all required hosts.
records.implication: Keep global-learning-intake staged and out of the fleet. The final bounded cycle admitted on Hermes but lost one valid Codex comparative case; do not weaken the suite, add a fourth adaptation, or leave an admitted GitHub workflow pointing at the unavailable owner.

records.claim: The unchanged 15-skill admitted fleet is mechanically synchronized and currently discoverable without duplicate portable owners across Hermes 0.21.0, Codex 0.152.0, and OMP 17.2.13.
records.implication: No fleet apply is needed. Keep capability-curator, global-learning-intake, primary-source-research, and surface-convergence excluded; after the Hermes runtime change, treat 0.20.6 host-specific behavior evaluations as historical and require a new sealed episode before any future promotion attempt.

records.claim: A multi-provider free-tier auto-router is reliable enough to serve as the default execution route for serious, long-running agent work.
records.implication: Do not admit FreeLLMAPI or another free-tier auto-router as a default serious-work route without a stable provider. Reconsider only for isolated low-stakes or stateless work with an explicit logical model, same-model provider failover, fail-closed exhaustion, and verification before durable state or external actions.
